items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: You remember the old man? Yes. Paul and Louis' father.

ctx.x: His son's a trumpet player. He looks like they got enough fellas in New Orleans to give a dollar a piece and a barrel.

Oh yeah. They're gonna do the right thing. But they don't. They know he's playing music. That business looks like all of them ought to have got a hip. Well they had a band for, is it or a barbering? Yes sir.
Last Thursday he was buried. You remember the old man? Yes.
